snippet.title: DAVY x JONES | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Ascend to the highest fathom of a pirate underworld with the infamous Davy Jones on this action-packed, revenge-driven journey. Control the captain's headless body, stay on pace with his autonomous skull and keep his legend alive.

DAVY x JONES is coming to PC & Consoles.

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611170/DAVY_x_JONES/
